services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of mining and commodity inputs against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 20.7 in September 2026, it is above its 5-year norm; it rose from 18.0 a month earlier but is below 25.5 three months earlier. ABS mining capex expectations is the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while NSW coal export value is the largest negative contributor (-5.0).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 36.0 in October 2026, it is above its five-year norm and has risen from 30.4 a month earlier and 12.8 six months earlier. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the largest negative (-9.4); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -16.0 in October 2026, it is below its five-year norm, improving from -27.0 a month earlier but below -10.8 three months ago and 16.1 a year ago; fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the biggest positive contributor (+5.9) and AUD/USD the biggest negative (-21.8). Tungsten policy flags are excluded until sufficient history is available.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 6 agreements, 1 cell ordered and 4 commissioned cells, with $7.2 million in stated contracted value, all unrecognised where stated. Over the past six months, it added these positions, including Komatsu’s $2.4 million first licensing agreement and operational first cell, a second Komatsu agreement and cell order, and a Metal 7 collaboration agreement.
